info.title: Scarlet.Bun.Cli - Bun as a .NET tool
info.description: Run Bun, the fast all-in-one JavaScript runtime and bundler, as a .NET tool: `dotnet bun install`, `dotnet bun run build.mjs`. Platform-specific packages embed the matching Bun binary, so `dotnet tool restore` works offline and pins Bun through .config/dotnet-tools.json - no download, no network, hash-verified by NuGet. Every argument is forwarded to Bun verbatim.

x-inspectra.cliParsedTitle: Bun is a fast JavaScript runtime, package manager, bundler, and test runner.

commands.name: audit
commands.description: Check installed packages for vulnerabilities

options.name: --json
options.description: Output in JSON format

options.name: --audit-level
options.description: Only print advisories with severity greater than or equal to <level> (low, moderate, high, critical)

options.name: --ignore
options.description: Ignore advisories by GHSA or numeric advisory ID (repeatable)

options.name: --latest
options.description: Also apply fixes your declared ranges exclude, rewriting package.json

commands.description: vite                 Create a new project from a template (bun c)

commands.name: dedupe
commands.description: Remove duplicate versions from the lockfile

options.name: --check
options.description: Exit with code 1 if the lockfile has duplicate versions that can be removed, without changing anything

options.name: --dry-run

options.description: Rewrite bun.lock without installing

options.name: --linker
options.description: Install with the given linker (one of "isolated" or "hoisted")
